title: Bamako anti-France reparations rally and effigy burning
reason: APRNEWS body reports approximately 150 attendees, but their demand was directed to the government of France for colonial reparations, not the Mali state. Exclude from Mali own-state protest records.
notes: APRNEWS is the sole opened source used for event details. Afrique Média's later exact URL returned 403 and is not independent confirmation; no retry. Petition's >100,000 signatures are not rally turnout.
